scope: 固定参考的样式与组合边界核对；不代替真实组件矩阵或逐像素等价声明。

references.name: alert
references.reviewNote: Pinned default uses neutral card surface/foreground and an independent descriptive level. Semantic success/warning/info variants and close/actions are project extensions.

references.name: sidebar
references.reviewNote: 核对中性侧栏、内容独立滚动、选中/焦点配对和移动端 Sheet；AppMainLayout 与 Tree 的能力是项目组合扩展。

references.name: avatar
references.reviewNote: Circular image/fallback, 24/32/40px named geometry, and group ring match the pinned reference. Square shape, semantic variants, actionable avatar and count behavior remain documented library extensions.

references.name: badge
references.reviewNote: Pinned reference is a compact inline pill with paired foreground/background and border variants. Anchored counters, dots and processing states are explicit project extensions.

references.name: chart
references.reviewNote: 核对轴文字、网格边界、数值层级与中性提示表面；仅借鉴展示原则，不引入 Recharts 或声称专业图表完全等价。

references.name: breadcrumb
references.reviewNote: Wrapped hierarchy, secondary ancestors and a foreground current location align with the fixed reference. Native link/button semantics and maxCount are library extensions; the current page remains non-interactive.

references.name: button
references.reviewNote: 核对默认/描边/次级/文字/危险变体、图标间距、五档尺寸与焦点状态；MD3 Expressive 等专有扩展保留自己的映射。

references.name: card
references.reviewNote: Pinned source separates header/action/content/footer, neutral card foreground and border/elevation. Clickable/loading behavior is a library extension and requires independent child keyboard activation.

references.name: checkbox
references.reviewNote: Pinned source defines 16px box, 4px radius, primary/on-primary checked state and explicit invalid/disabled focus. Project size and mixed-state extensions retain native checkbox semantics.

references.name: popover
references.reviewNote: Pinned reference uses paired popover colors, border/shadow, origin-based motion and portal anchoring. Project DropdownContainer owns Web placement and close semantics.

references.name: tabs
references.reviewNote: 核对默认与线型容器、活动项前景、下划线、焦点和禁用；关闭、拖动及项目尺寸按公共语义另验。

references.name: select
references.reviewNote: 核对触发器高度/标签/占位、弹层表面、条目焦点和选择标记；多选、过滤与清除为项目扩展。

references.name: calendar
references.reviewNote: 核对导航、日期网格、单选和范围首尾/中段配对、焦点层级；本库日期/时间与国际化行为单独验收。

references.name: dialog
references.reviewNote: Pinned source establishes overlay, bounded neutral surface, named heading, close button and responsive footer. Project native dialog and async confirm/cancel semantics are checked independently.

references.name: separator
references.reviewNote: 核对 1px 边界、横竖方向及非收缩布局；标题分隔为项目扩展。

references.name: sheet
references.reviewNote: Pinned reference separates directional surface motion, overlay and named heading/footer. Project Drawer uses native modal/scroll ownership and nested-layer focus restoration.

references.name: form
references.reviewNote: 核对标签、辅助说明、错误文字与字段关联；本库状态和提交协议不依赖参考实现的表单运行时。

references.name: navigation-menu
references.reviewNote: 核对导航触发器、活动/悬停/焦点、弹层表面和方向动效；项目 Menu 的横向、内联与折叠模式分别检查。

references.name: pagination
references.reviewNote: 核对导航地标、当前位置与前后入口、禁用语义和省略标记；跳页与页容量为项目扩展。

references.name: radio-group
references.reviewNote: Pinned source defines circular 16px control, primary 8px dot, disabled opacity and focus/error ring. Native radio group keyboard behavior and project sizes are reviewed separately.

references.name: skeleton
references.reviewNote: 核对中性占位表面、形状与脉冲；强制颜色和减少动画保留占位用途。

references.name: slider
references.reviewNote: Pinned source separates muted track, primary range, bordered thumb, focus ring and disabled opacity. Wheel editing, density and scientific steps are library extensions with preserved event reasons.

references.name: resizable
references.reviewNote: 核对分隔线、独立拖动命中层、方向与焦点；项目比例/像素及键盘调整为扩展。

references.name: switch
references.reviewNote: Pinned source uses a compact pill track, background thumb and checked/unchecked dark roles. Project large and compact variants remain documented extensions.

references.name: table
references.reviewNote: 核对行边界、悬停/选中配对、表头字重与滚动容器；虚拟化、编辑、排序与数据反馈是本库专业能力。

references.name: textarea
references.reviewNote: 核对稳定字段边界、标签/说明、明暗输入表面与焦点/禁用/错误；项目多行尺寸和计数独立检查。

references.name: tooltip
references.reviewNote: 核对反色语义对、紧凑排版、Portal 和方向动效；本库键盘/指针关闭及嵌套边界单独验证。

references.name: input
references.reviewNote: 核对字段轮廓、占位、选中文本、焦点/错误与明暗表面；LineEdit/NumberEdit 共享公共字段布局，数字解析为扩展。

references.name: dropdown-menu
references.reviewNote: Pinned reference distinguishes focus/selection, submenu motion and independent item icons. Project Menu also supports navigation layouts and remains a documented extension.
